capabilities: Import watchlist, lists, watched history and ratings as one note per movie or show
Match and update existing notes by media ID while keeping note bodies
Format filenames with LiquidJS filters such as slugify and truncate
Fetch posters, genres and descriptions for watchlist and list items
Preview new, updated, skipped and dropped notes before applying changes
extras: Sync is manual and one-way only, and seasons and episodes are skipped. The API key is stored in Obsidian SecretStorage and must be selected again on each device. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; poster embeds load from a remote image host.
problem: Watchlist, rating and watched-history data kept on MDBList stays outside the vault, so it cannot be filtered, linked or reviewed alongside notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin syncs manually, one way, from MDBList into your vault.
Filter and group your library with Obsidian Bases, Dataview, or search.

summary: One-way sync that turns an MDBList watchlist, lists, watched history and ratings into movie and TV notes in the vault.
